headline: Restrictive, and tightening again at the front end. A strong October jobs report (+165K, 4.1% unemployment) and a second straight 0.3% core CPI pushed December hike odds to about 90%, lifting the 2-year to 4.88% and the 10-year to 5.15%, while the dollar hit a 19-month high and oil fell roughly 15% this month. Underwrite to a 10-year above 5% and assume floating-rate debt costs another 25 bp by year-end; cheaper oil and narrower credit spreads help at the margin, but don't expect lender terms to loosen before the Fed's Dec 9 decision.
